graph.title: LEGO 30313-1 Garbage Truck (page 1, steps 1-8)
notes: The page shows steps 1-8 at small scale; piece identities and exact attachment points are best estimates.
Step 1: gray clip plate (lego-60470b) on the black vehicle base. Step 2: white clip brick on the left, white 1x2 plate placed on the gray piece.
Step 3: lime 1x2 brick. Step 4: two white sloped bricks plus a second white clip brick. Step 5: green 2x3 plate on top.
Step 6: white bracket at the back. Step 7: second green 2x3 plate with two white corner panels and a lime round plate. Step 8: two black mechanical arms clipped on the clip bricks.
Wheels, tyres, figure, trash cans, tools, seat and other remaining parts are not clearly placed on this page and are left for later pages.
Small-scale images; piece placement is best estimate. Exact attachment points of the seat, tiles, cone, broom, shovel and trash cans are guessed.
Step 12: bar lego-30374 is pushed into the rear clips of the gray clip plate (b2).

Step 14: two trash cans each get a lime round plate (lego-6141) and hang from the black arms; this uses more lime 6141 than the earlier guess for b14, so b14 may actually be a different part (e.g. the lime brick stud).
Broom and shovel are placed on the reddish brown round plates, which sit on the cargo plate; real attachment is unclear.
Step 15: four wheel+tyre pairs on the base. The minifigure is not in the parts list and is omitted.

The 'can' repeat is re-stated and supersedes the earlier 'can' repeat: the round green lids on the trash cans are lego-4740 Dish 2x2 Inverted (Green), not lime lego-6141. This removes the extra lime 6141 and adds the two missing 4740 pieces.
With lids corrected, lime lego-6141 appears as b14 plus b29 (2 total, matching the list). b29 is a lime stud plate on the green cargo plate; exact position is a guess.

lego-4865a (b30) and the two lego-6231 corner panels (b31, b32) are white body panels that were missed before. They are probably part of the white cab/hood bodywork in steps 4-11; the exact attachment points are guessed and set to the base b1.
No other change to the existing graph.

The 'can' repeat is stated again under the same group name and replaces the earlier 'can' repeat (and its earlier restatement). The lid is now written directly as lego-4740 Dish 2x2 Inverted (Green) instead of using a replace override that did not take effect.
The lids in step 14 are green dishes, not lime round plates. Lime lego-6141 is then only b14 and b29 (2 pieces, matching the list), and reddish brown lego-6141 is b27 and b28.
If the old 'can' repeats are kept as well as this one, the lime 6141 lids and the 4740 lids would be double counted. This version is meant to be the only 'can' repeat.
Nothing else changes.
